def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 1000
    annual_coupon = 50
    term_years = 5
    yield_to_maturity = 0.04

    cash_flows = [annual_coupon] * (term_years - 1)
    cash_flows.append(annual_coupon + face_value)

    # Calculate the bond price and present-value-weighted cash flows
    present_values = [
        cash_flow / ((1 + yield_to_maturity) ** year)
        for year, cash_flow in enumerate(cash_flows, start=1)
    ]
    bond_price = sum(present_values)

    weighted_present_value = sum(
        year * present_value
        for year, present_value in enumerate(present_values, start=1)
    )

    # Calculate Macaulay duration
    macaulay_duration = weighted_present_value / bond_price

    # Return the answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(macaulay_duration, 2)
